newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Feb inflation to be below 2 pct -deputy PM.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Feb inflation to be below 2 pct -deputy PM.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation rate should fall below two percent in February, from January's 2.2 percent, Deputy Prime Minister Viktor Pynzenyk told Reuters on Thursday.
"The inflation rate in February will be lower than in January and no more than two percent," he said.
The 1997 draft budget predicts annual 1997 inflation of 24.8 percent, dwon from 39.7 percent in 1996 and 181.7 percent in 1995.
Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko said last week the government planned to raise rents and utility prices in the second half of the year, but the move would not affect monthly inflation.
